findings.summary: Changing the type assertion from obj.(Mock) to obj.(*Mock) breaks legacy by-value Mock callers: they no longer match, so the later obj.(assertExpectationser) assertion panics because AssertExpectations has a pointer receiver.
A valid *Mock argument now wrongly triggers the "Deprecated" log message in AssertExpectationsForObjects.

With mutex now a sync.Mutex value, copying a Mock by value (including user structs embedding Mock, e.g. via value receivers) copies the lock, triggers go vet copylocks warnings, and shares lock state.
